kebab_example: aliyun dfs create-access-rule --input-region-id cn-hangzhou --access-group-id acg-e3755fb0-358d-4286-9942-8d4610480000 --network-segment 192.0.2.0/24 --rw-access-type RDWR --priority 2 --description '日志上传机器网段' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccessRule

parameters.help_en: IP address or network segment of the authorization object
parameters.help_zh: 授权对象的IP地址或网段
parameters.name: network_segment

parameters.help_en:
Read and write permissions of the authorization object on the file system.

Valid values:

RDWR: read-write
RDONLY: read-only
parameters.help_zh:
授权对象对文件系统的读写权限。

取值：

RDWR：可读可写
RDONLY：只读
parameters.name: rw_access_type

parameters.help_en:
Priority of the permission group rule.

When the same authorization object matches multiple rules, the rule with the highest priority takes effect.

Valid values: 1 to 100. A value of 1 indicates the highest priority
parameters.help_zh:
权限组规则优先级。

当同一个授权对象匹配到多条规则时，高优先级规则生效。

取值范围：1~100，1为最高优先级
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
Description of the permission group rule.

The length cannot exceed 32 characters
parameters.help_zh:
权限组规则描述。

长度不超过32个字符
parameters.name: description
